tips.title: NEVER DIG STRAIGHT DOWN
tips.body: You can drop into a cave or straight into lava. Dig a staircase instead and keep a block under your feet.

tips.title: DIAMONDS LIVE DEEP
tips.body: Diamonds are most common near the bottom of the world. Bring an iron pickaxe or better, or they drop nothing.

tips.title: SLEEP IN A BED
tips.body: Sleeping sets your spawn point and skips the night. Die far from home and you come back next to your bed.

tips.title: WATER SAVES YOU
tips.body: Landing in water cancels fall damage. Pros place a water bucket right before they hit the ground.

tips.title: LIGHT IT UP
tips.body: Hostile mobs only spawn in total darkness. Place torches in caves and around your base to keep them away.
